short_description: Philips Ace Saver 9 W B22 LED bulb, 806 lm cool day light 6500 K, EyeComfort low-glare light, no UV or IR. Made in India.
long_description:
## What it is

The Philips Ace Saver 9 W B22 Cool Day Light LED bulb (Philips 12NC 929001198414) is the value tier of Philips India's household lamp range and the model most Indian buyers mean when they ask for "a Philips bulb". It is a round polycarbonate lamp with a frosted envelope and a B22 bayonet cap, drawing 9 W and delivering 806 lumens at 6500 K cool day light. It is made and packed in India by Philips India Ltd at Nalagarh, Himachal Pradesh.

## What it's for

Everyday indoor lighting: living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and passages, and equally at home in an office or a shop on an existing B22 holder. It goes straight into the holder an ordinary incandescent bulb came out of, with no rewiring and no change of fitting.

## Key specifications

The lamp runs on 220-240 V AC mains and consumes 9 W for 806 lumens, which works out at roughly 90 lumens per watt. Colour is 6500 K cool day light with a colour rendering index around 80. Philips builds the range around its EyeComfort claim: glare is reduced and light flicker minimised so the light does not cause eye strain or fatigue over a long evening. The beam carries no infra-red, so the lamp radiates no heat forward, and no ultra-violet, so fabrics and pictures under it do not fade. The body and diffuser are polycarbonate. The lamp measures 60 mm across and 110 mm tall and is non-dimmable.

## Application and installation notes

Push the cap into a standard B22 bayonet holder and twist a quarter turn to lock. Keep it off dimmer and regulator circuits — it is not a dimmable lamp. Avoid fully enclosed fittings, which trap the heat the driver needs to shed. Indoor use only; no IP rating is declared, so it is not for open verandas or outdoor fittings. Because the envelope is polycarbonate and not glass, a knock that would shatter a filament bulb generally will not break it.

## What's in the box

One lamp in a printed Philips carton carrying the 12NC, the EAN barcode and the MRP block. Philips also packs the same lamp in 2, 3, 4, 6 and 10-lamp multipacks. The usual Philips lamp warranty is one year from date of purchase, claimed through the seller or Philips India consumer care.
